details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1236-1252 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_rb_valid_repo_relative_path` accepts untrusted repo-relative paths without rejecting shell metacharacters and other unsafe encodings.
  WHY: The validator only filters a narrow set of characters, so malicious-looking path strings can still survive into later shell/git handling.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:14-17 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `exec 3>&1` unconditionally overwrites file descriptor 3.
  WHY: If the caller already uses fd 3, the script can misroute GitHub Actions warnings or clobber unrelated output.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:81-120 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `validate_repo_relative_path_syntax` does not account for URL-encoded traversal-like path strings.
  WHY: A printable path such as `%2e%2e%2f...` can be treated as syntactically valid even though downstream consumers may reject or reinterpret it later.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:314-340 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `parse_blocks`/`verify_prior_round` can treat malformed continuation or empty-file context as if it matched cleanly.
  WHY: The fixed two-space continuation handling and empty `FILE` equality both let verifier state diverge from the original block content.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:230-258 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The shell-side `quote:` validation and Python-side quote extraction do not use the same evidence semantics.
  WHY: Multiple `quote:` lines are accepted by the shell check, but the verifier only evaluates the first quote, so later supporting evidence can be ignored.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~370-410 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `normalize_generated_items` requires the generated item count to match the issue count exactly.
  WHY: Any off-by-one synthesis result discards the entire round instead of salvaging valid items.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:348-380 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `mktemp` failure for stderr capture is silently tolerated.
  WHY: When temp-file creation fails, retries lose stderr diagnostics and the final failure becomes much harder to debug.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:100-155 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `load_candidates` makes redundant full-text copies of judge output.
  WHY: Large outputs are copied and rescanned multiple times, increasing memory pressure and CPU use unnecessarily.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1265-1267 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The baseline branch name can collide when run metadata is empty or otherwise non-unique.
  WHY: `GITHUB_RUN_ID`/`GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` are part of the uniqueness scheme, so missing or empty values can produce duplicate branch names and push failures.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:337-417 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `checkout_ref.outputs.source` no longer preserves the `prior_pr_baseline_branch` signal.
  WHY: Downstream tooling that keyed off that output value will now only see `integration/default`, breaking the external contract even though the new flow still works internally.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:195-314 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Failed `CODEX_HOME`/`~/.codex` copy operations are swallowed.
  WHY: The interim judge can continue with stale or incomplete config without warning, which can change model behavior and downstream artifacts.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1265-1267 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new baseline branch format is incompatible with the old `ai/reissue-pr-...` format.
  WHY: Existing reissue references using the old branch shape can be rejected by the resolver, creating a backward-compatibility break for in-flight or archived workflows.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:83 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `type(line_start) is not int` is a brittle integer check.
  WHY: The code rejects valid int subclasses and relies on identity instead of the normal numeric type predicate.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:351-365 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trap can try to remove partially created or missing temp directories.
  WHY: Under interruption or partial setup, cleanup can become noisy or slow instead of being a simple best-effort teardown.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~620 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `delimiter_for` has an unbounded collision-search loop.
  WHY: A pathological generated payload that contains every candidate delimiter can spin until timeout rather than failing fast.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1376 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Push failures can be misclassified as baseline-branch setup failures.
  WHY: The caller maps exit code 3 to the setup path, which can produce misleading diagnostics when the real failure is in `git push`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1099-1128 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Missing required support files fail the workflow without emitting a GitHub Actions error annotation.
  WHY: Operators get only a nonzero exit code in the logs, not an inline `::error::` message explaining the missing file.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:276-285 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `sed` patching of `config.toml` is fragile around replacement escaping.
  WHY: The substitution logic does not fully account for all `sed`-sensitive characters, so malformed config edits are possible if inputs ever expand beyond the expected fixed set.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:236-247 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `parse_patch` can misclassify deleted-file evidence paths.
  WHY: A deletion with sparse or missing diff markers can fall into the wrong verification branch and produce an incorrect support/inconclusive outcome.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1236-1249 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Path validator does not reject shell metacharacters in untrusted path values extracted from the judge JSON.
  WHY: The current checks only cover newline, carriage-return, and tab characters, so a path like `src/\$(whoami).py` can still pass validation and flow into later shell interpolation contexts.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:83-97 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `validate_repo_relative_path_syntax` does not detect URL-encoded traversal sequences.
  WHY: Printable inputs like `%2e%2e%2f` can be classified as syntactically valid even though they are not safe repo-relative paths.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~370-410 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `normalize_generated_items` requires an exact item-count match.
  WHY: If the synthesizer returns one extra or one missing item, the whole smoke round is discarded via `json_parse_failed` instead of salvaging the valid subset.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:17 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `exec 3>&1` unconditionally duplicates stdout onto fd 3.
  WHY: If the caller already has fd 3 open, this can silently clobber it and misroute the warnings that the script emits through fd 3.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:320-340 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `verify_prior_round` can accept empty `FILE` fields as if they matched.
  WHY: When both the current block and the prior artifact have empty file anchors, the strict string comparison passes and the verifier can return a false support verdict.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:395-435 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `parse_blocks` assumes every continuation line starts with exactly two spaces.
  WHY: If a continuation line is formatted differently, the parser preserves the wrong leading whitespace and can later fail to match the original excerpt.
- scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:230-258 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Shell-side quote counting and Python-side quote consumption are asymmetric.
  WHY: The shell validates that at least one `quote:` line exists, while the Python verifier only uses the first quote, so later supporting quotes are ignored.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:delimiter_for function | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The delimiter-collision loop is unbounded.
  WHY: In a pathological case where every candidate delimiter is present in the generated content, the loop can run until the surrounding timeout kills the process.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:348-380 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `mktemp` failure for the stderr capture file is silently tolerated.
  WHY: Retry attempts then lose stderr output, which removes the diagnostics needed to understand repeated API failures.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:100-155 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `load_candidates` makes multiple full copies of the raw output.
  WHY: The repeated string operations and JSON scanning create unnecessary memory pressure and CPU churn for large judge outputs.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:337-417 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `Resolve checkout ref` step no longer emits `source=prior_pr_baseline_branch`.
  WHY: External tools that depended on that output key to detect baseline-preserved reissues will now only see `integration/default`, which breaks their signal.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1265-1267 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The baseline branch name can collide when `GITHUB_RUN_ID` or `GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` are empty.
  WHY: The fallback `:-0` scheme can still produce duplicate branch names, causing push failures and a fallback to redo mode.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:302-314 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Copy failures for `CODEX_HOME` are swallowed.
  WHY: The judge can proceed with stale or incomplete config in its temp environment without warning, which can distort the run.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:351-365 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trap can run against missing or partially populated temp paths.
  WHY: Best-effort teardown becomes fragile under interruption and can waste time or leave leftover temp directories.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1099-1128 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Missing support files cause a plain exit 1 without an error annotation.
  WHY: The workflow fails, but the operator does not get an inline GitHub Actions error explaining which file is missing.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1376 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Exit code 3 from a push failure can be logged as a setup failure.
  WHY: The error classification path conflates push-time failure with branch-setup failure, which makes debugging misleading.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
